fib: ______ is a limited government, whereas most socialist constitutions, although written, do not place limits on what the government can do.
constitutional government
A constitutional government is a limited government, whereas most socialist constitutions, although written, do not place limits on what the government can do.
______ means the description of ethical ideas without presenting an opinion on their rightness.
Descriptive ethics
Descriptive ethics means the description of ethical ideas without presenting an opinion on their rightness.
______ refer to the common law doctrines, either as a way of understanding APA provisions or even as independent sources of limits on agency action.
Courts sometimes still
Courts sometimes still refer to the common law doctrines, either as a way of understanding APA provisions or even as independent sources of limits on agency action.
______ is the bye product of the growing socio-economic functions of the state and the increased powers of the government.
Administrative law
Administrative law is the bye product of the growing socio-economic functions of the state and the increased powers of the government.
______ means the rules and principles regulating the behaviour of individuals.
Ethics
Ethics means the rules and principles regulating the behaviour of individuals.

______ is the machinery through which government designs and implements its policies; it is the organ created to ensure that policies and programmes of any government at any particular time are carried out.
civil service

The civil service is the machinery through which government designs and implements its policies; it is the organ created to ensure that policies and programmes of any government at any particular time are carried out.
______ is the body responsible for the implementation, enforcement and administration of the laws made by the legislative arm of government.
executive
The executive is the body responsible for the implementation, enforcement and administration of the laws made by the legislative arm of government.
______ is the ears of the people because it serves as a mechanism of redressing the grievances of citizens in a political system.
institution
The institution is the ears of the people because it serves as a mechanism of redressing the grievances of citizens in a political system.
______ is an agency of effective public administration.
Ombudsman
The Ombudsman is an agency of effective public administration.
______ are those public servants who are direct employees of both federal and state governments other than the police, armed forces personnel, and the teachers.
Civil servants
Civil servants are those public servants who are direct employees of both federal and state governments other than the police, armed forces personnel, and the teachers.
______ is the head of the executive and acts on the advice of the Council of Ministers.
President
The President is the head of the executive and acts on the advice of the Council of Ministers.
______ is a pointer to the fact that there is no consensus as to the function of the agency.
different classifications
The different classifications is a pointer to the fact that there is no consensus as to the function of the agency.
______ is the process of performing particular acts, of issuing particular orders, or (as usually) of making decisions which apply general rules to particular cases.
Execution
Execution is the process of performing particular acts, of issuing particular orders, or (as usually) of making decisions which apply general rules to particular cases.

______ is the machinery that Government uses to render services to the people and as such, public servants should think of how they can constantly and conveniently improve themselves to give better service.
public service

The public service is the machinery that Government uses to render services to the people and as such, public servants should think of how they can constantly and conveniently improve themselves to give better service.
______ are the agencies of government vested with the powers to legislate on the matters which ordinarily falls within the legislative powers of the legislatures.
Administrative Institutions
Administrative Institutions are the agencies of government vested with the powers to legislate on the matters which ordinarily falls within the legislative powers of the legislatures.
